description: Unit test class for EntityTagValueValidator in the Eclipse Ditto framework, testing validation and behavior of entity tags.

classes.name: EntityTagValueValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for EntityTagValueValidator, checking validation logic and immutability.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Sets up static test data before all tests, initializes a valid EntityTag string.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the validator instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the EntityTagValueValidator class is immutable.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Tests that accepting a null definition throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Tests that accepting a null value throws DittoHeaderInvalidException.

methods.name: canValidateEntityTag
methods.description: Checks that EntityTag class is recognized as valid for validation.

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequence
methods.description: Ensures a valid EntityTag string is accepted without exceptions.

methods.name: doesNotValidateAsDefinedJavaTypeIsNotEntityTag
methods.description: Verifies that validation does not occur for unrelated header definitions.

methods.name: acceptNonEntityTagString
methods.description: Ensures invalid string not recognized as EntityTag causes exception.

methods.name: acceptInvalidEntityTagString
methods.description: Tests recognition of malformed EntityTag strings and the thrown exception details.
